note: Plain-English, one-sentence descriptions of each Practice Standards module for the questionnaire result page. Written by the product owner for Readyline; NOT NDIS Quality and Safeguards Commission text. Module ids match data/standards.json; poId is the slug used in the PO's review text.
author: readyline

items.description: The standards every registered provider is audited against: participants' rights, how your business is run, how supports are delivered, and the environments you deliver them in.
A smaller set of four standards (people, incidents, complaints, risk) checked by a document review for lower-risk supports.
Extra standards for daily personal care that needs specific clinical skills, such as complex bowel care, tube feeding or ventilation.
Standards for practitioners who assess behaviour and write behaviour support plans.
Standards for providers whose workers carry out behaviour support plans, including any regulated restrictive practices.
Standards for early intervention with young children and their families.
Standards for support coordination in complex or high-risk situations.
Standards for owning or managing specialist disability accommodation as the housing provider.
Standards, from 1 July 2026, for managing and delivering supported independent living packages: decision-making, safeguarding, practice governance and tenancy arrangements.
